newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar drifts lower, lacks physical news.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar drifts lower, lacks physical news.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was just lower by late morning, after nearby months opened marginally up.
The market was just drifting and lacks new physical news, traders said.
The market needed new demand to move higher, one trader said.
By 1020 GMT August was 90 cents lower at $321.00. August volume was 186 lots of a total 404 done so far.
New York world sugar futures closed firmer but off the day's highs on Tuesday after early buying failed to attract follow-through, trading sources said.
